speech.heard: Somalia has 15.3% of young girls. South Korea has just 3.3%. One big country breaks this pattern. It's not the one you'd guess. The USA, China or Nigeria. Nigeria, 13.3%. That is 3.7 times the young girls Japan has. The world's highest are Somalia, 15.3%, Niger, 15.2% and Mali, 15.1%. It counts the female population between the ages 5 to 9 as a percentage of the total female population. The USA has 5.6%, China has 5.4%. What share of your country's female population are young girls?
